name: BaseLayout
summary: App shell: document head, paired Plex typography, header/footer, and global client behaviour.
what: Wraps every page with metadata, IBM Plex Sans and Mono, the base and editorial theme stylesheets, GridBackdrop, and Header/Footer.
why: Centralises page chrome and restrained vanilla-JS behaviour while preserving the same reading width across routes.
whenToUse: Use bare=true for gated/standalone screens that should hide nav.
whenNotToUse: Do not import inside another component - it is a top-level layout.
Do not re-implement route/reveal observers in a page; they already live here.
a11yNotes: Respects prefers-reduced-motion and keeps content visible without JavaScript.
source: Generated from Astro source + design-system/ai/index.json by component-metadata.py.
